steps.en: Company email addresses come from stored records
steps.id: Alamat email perusahaan diambil dari data tersimpan
steps.why_en: The lookup from an external data source is switched off; only stored email addresses are used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian ke sumber data luar dimatikan; hanya email tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each unique company owner is picked only once per run
steps.id: Tiap perusahaan unik dipilih hanya sekali per pengiriman
steps.why_en: Notices are merged per company only when their step and due date match, so one company can still get several emails.
steps.why_id: Notice digabung per perusahaan hanya jika tahap dan due date sama, jadi satu perusahaan masih bisa dapat beberapa email.

steps.en: Only company owners receive the email
steps.id: Hanya pemilik perusahaan yang menerima email
steps.why_en: Story is Removed; code exists but is not claimed
steps.why_id: Story Removed; code ada tapi tidak diklaim

steps.en: Email text comes from a template staff can edit
steps.id: Isi email berasal dari template yang bisa diedit staff
steps.why_en: Story is Removed; code exists but is not claimed
steps.why_id: Story Removed; code ada tapi tidak diklaim

steps.en: Email shows the charges, but no admin fee
steps.id: Email memuat biaya, tanpa admin fee
steps.why_en: No admin fee value is passed to the email text; admin fee is only applied at later letter stages.
steps.why_id: Nilai admin fee tidak dikirim ke teks email; admin fee baru dipakai di tahap surat berikutnya.

steps.en: The system sends the email to each company owner automatically
steps.id: Sistem mengirim email ke tiap pemilik perusahaan secara otomatis
steps.why_en: Sending is built, but the automatic schedule is switched off in the settings and not yet live.
steps.why_id: Fitur kirim sudah ada, tapi jadwal otomatisnya dimatikan di pengaturan dan belum aktif.
